steps.name: a2p-1-picker-bar
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p1.log"; python3 tools/run_tests.py hub.tests.test_a2p_bar hub.tests.test_ui hub.tests.test_anonymity > "$V" 2>&1 || { tail -60 "$V"; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_a2p_bar ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_ui ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_anonymity ' "$V" || { echo MISSING MODULE; grep -E 'hub' "$V" | head -60; exit 1; }; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; ! grep -n 'innerHTML' hub/static/views/sessions.js hub/static/app.js || { echo INNERHTML; exit 1; }; ! grep -nE '<select[^>]*chat-project' hub/static/index.html || { echo SELECT BAR; exit 1; }; grep -q 'picker-new-claude' hub/static/index.html && grep -q 'aria-controls="session-picker"' hub/static/index.html || { echo BAR CONTRACT; exit 1; }; grep -E '^run_tests:' "$V"

steps.name: a2p-2-dropdown-handoff
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p2.log"; python3 tools/run_tests.py > "$V" 2>&1 || { tail -60 "$V"; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_a2p_bar ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_a2p_dropdown ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_ui ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_sessions_ui ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_anonymity ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_image_imports ' "$V" || { echo MISSING MODULE; grep -E 'hub' "$V" | head -60; exit 1; }; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; ! grep -nE 'window[.]open|XMLHttpRequest' hub/static/views/sessions.js || { echo POPUP XHR; exit 1; }; ! grep -n 'innerHTML' hub/static/views/sessions.js hub/static/views/running.js || { echo INNERHTML; exit 1; }; grep -q 'location[.]assign' hub/static/views/sessions.js && grep -q 'encodeURIComponent' hub/static/views/sessions.js || { echo NO HANDOFF; exit 1; }; grep -E '^run_tests:' "$V"

steps.name: a2p-3-browser-acceptance
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p3.log"; python3 tools/run_tests.py > "$V" 2>&1 || { tail -60 "$V"; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_a2p_bar ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_a2p_dropdown ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_a2p_browser ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_ui ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_sessions_ui ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_anonymity ' "$V" && grep -qE '^ok +hub[.]tests[.]test_image_imports ' "$V" || { echo MISSING MODULE; grep -E 'hub' "$V" | head -60; exit 1; }; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; S="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/a2p-shots"; for f in 390x800-light-closed 390x800-light-open 390x800-dark-closed 390x800-dark-open 1440x900-light-closed 1440x900-light-open 1440x900-dark-closed 1440x900-dark-open; do test -s "$S/$f.png" || { echo MISSING SHOT "$S/$f.png"; exit 1; }; done; grep -E '^run_tests:' "$V"
